steps: Answer from the 13 Ebda Chat help articles; Chat actions belong to the Chat adapter, not this catalogue.
edgeCases: Meta fees change; link to the article

Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
